$comment: The SSE event contract between the Reasoner backend and its client SDKs.
OpenAPI cannot describe an SSE stream, so this file stands in for it. Both
sides test against it: tests/test_sdk_contract.py asserts the backend still
produces these keys, and sdk/typescript/test/contract.test.ts asserts the
SDK still consumes them. A backend change that drops a key fails the Python
test; an SDK change that stops reading one fails the TypeScript test.
Only keys an SDK actually depends on belong here. This is a floor, not an
inventory: the backend may emit more, and new event types are added without
a version bump, so clients must ignore what they do not recognise.

done.description: Terminal frame of every run. Carries cost, tokens, and timing.
notes: total_cost_usd is the figure charged against credits — the backend's own
_extract_run_cost reads it off this frame to settle the run.
A crashed pipeline emits a reduced done frame carrying only type and errors,
so consumers must treat every key but type as optional at read time.
